''''Solar Kingdom'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It rotates into Famous Painter Lupini's stock on Winter 17 during the [[Night Market]] starting in year 1, and reappears on Winter 17 every 3 years.  It can be purchased for {{Price|1200}}.
